tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ phyag rdor stob po che'i nyams len rgyun khyer zin bris bzhugs so// 218) ༄༅/ na mo gu ru sa mā dra na ye/ lha dang bla ma dbyer med la btud nas/ de nyid bsgrub thabs snying por bsdus te bri/ dben pa'i gnas su skyabs sems chos spyod rigs/ sngon du btang nas snod bcud stongs par sbyangs/ de nas rang gi nags de gnam lcags kyi/ rdo rje rtse lnga ri bo mchog rab tsam/ steng dang 'og nas gnam lcags 'khor lo ni/ kha sbyor phubs pa g.yas g.yon bsnol 'khor zhing*/ phyi rol padma rdo rje me ri yi/ bsrung ba'i gur gyis bar chad kun skyobs 219)bsam/ rdo rje'i lte ba gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i gdan dbus pad nyi'i steng*/ rang rig rdo rje rtse dgu hūm̐ gis mtshan/ de las 'od 'phros rgyal ba kun mchod cing*/ 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs gdugs pa can rnams btul/ 'od zer tshul 'dus yongs gyur skad cig gis/ bdag nyid phyag rdor gtum rngam mthing nag mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gdangs mi gzigs/ phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon pa ni/ lcags zhags pa dang bcas sdig 'dzub 220)mdzad/ dar sngon stod g.yogs stag lpags shal thabs dang*/ phyag zhabs sbrul dngarin chen gdub bus brgyan/ thod skam rigs lngas dbu brgyan ral pa 'bar/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang me dpungs klong bzhugs pa'i/ phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs la phyag rdor rigs bzhi ni/ dkar ser dmar ljang cha lugs gtso dang mthun/ sgo bzhi rta phag seng sbrul gdong can yang*/ phyogs mdog lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ de ltar 'khor tshogs rnams kyang rang rig gi/ rtsal mdangs nyi dang zer bzhin shugs 'byung bskyed/ gtso bo'i spyi bor zla steng oṃ dkar dang*/ mgrin par padma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag hūm̐ gi mtha' skor sngags phreng bskor ba las/ 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim/

slar yang 'od 'phros bde gshegs dbang gi lha/ rigs lnga spyan drangs bum pas dbang bskur zhing*/ chu lhag yar 221)lud mi skyod pas mtshan gyur/ thugs khar sa bon sngags phreng 'khor ba la/ 'dun pa gtad cing gsal stong ngang nyid las/ oṃ badzra tsanḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bsnyen pa'i sngags 'di 'bru 'bum bzla bya zhing*/ sa bon sngags phreng rnams las 'od zer tshogs/ yar 'phros rgyal ba kun mchod nus byin rnams/ bdag la thim zhing mar 'phros 'gro drug gi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas bde la bkod par dmigs/ thun mtshams mchod bstod bya zhing snod bcud kun/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim zhing hūm̐ nyid kyang*/ mi dmigs stong pa'i rgyas gdab dge ba bsngo/ slar yang rang lus lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ cir snang sgyu mar rol pa spyod lam bya/ 'di ltar 'bad pas dngos nyams rmi lam gyi/ rtag byang tshe na bsgrub dang las sbyor sngags/ gcig tu dril ba 'di nyid gsum 'bum bzla/ oṃ badzra tsanḍa ma hā ro ṣa 222)ṇa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di dus dmigs pa bdag lus gnas rnams dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga kun las khro bo'i tshogs/ dpag med tsha tsha lta bur 'phros pa yis/ gnod byed tshogs rnams rdul du brlag par bsam/ dmigs pa gzhan rnams gong dang mtshungs pa nyid/ 'di las rgyas pa sgrub pa dngos byed na/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs bri 'am tshom bu ni/ dbus su gcig dang mtha' bskor bzhi bkod cing*/ de rgyab bzhi bkod de dbus de dbus bum pa bshams/ g.yas su sku gzugs g.yon du gtor ma dang*/ mdun du phur bu mtha' skor sman rag gtor/ mchod pas bskor bshams dmigs pa'i rim pa ni/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin bum pa dkyil 'khor bcas/ gzhal yas yongs rdzogs nyid bsgom lha tshogs rnams/ bdag skyed ji bzhin bya zhing ye shes pa/ spyan 223)drangs bstims dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab sogs/

bdag bskyed dang mthun ye shes sems dpa' bstim/ bdag nyid thugs las 'od zer phar 'phros pas/ mdun skyed bum skyed gtso 'khor thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag rnams las 'od 'phros rgyal ba mchod/ byin rlabs nus mthu bsdus nas bdag mdun gyi/ gnas gsum thim pas gzi byin 'bar bsam la/ rtsa ba'i sngags dang sham bu 'dogs tshul sogs/ bsnyen dus dang mtshungs rtags 'thon bar du bsgrub/ sgrub pa thon tshe sku dang bum gter rnams/ rang gi gnas gsum btugs la dngos grub blangs/ ye shes sems dpa' rang gnas gshegs pa'am/ yang na sku gzugs de la bstim par bya/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi thugs khar bsdu/ sku dang seng phur rang dang 'bral mi bya/ 'dis ni dbang dang las mtha' la sogs pa/ 224)gzhan don ji ltar 'dod pa 'grub pa 'gyur/ de ltar bdag mdun bsnyen bsgrub gang dang gang*/ kun la rang rigs stong nyid don rtogs pa'i/ gsal snang gdangs nyid lha sngags gsal ba las/ a 'thas 'dzin pas bcing ba ma yin par/ gsal stong zung ngag ngang nas yongs med spyad/ gnas skabs phan gnod las tshogs tsam phyir du/ bsgrubs kyang re dog gzeb las ya grol bas/ nga bdag 'gong po phugs nas ma 'thon na/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob nas nye bar dka'/ skyed rdzogs dbyer med khyab bdag klong yangs nas/ bsgom med yengs med don gyi bsnyen bsgrub mchog mthun rkyen snying po'i go 'phang la reg tshe/ mthun mongs dngos grub mi 'dod 'char bzhin 'bab/ de phyir gdams pa'i gnad 'di lhag par gces/ 'di bris dge ba dpag yas gong 'phel 225)ba'i/ mthu yis 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin thob shog rig 'dzin chen po gar gyi dbang phyug gis/ yer pa rdo rje'i brag nas gdan drangs pa'i/ phyag na rdo rje stobs so che'i bsnyen bsgrub zhal gdams snyan rgyud ma 'di ni mtshungs med sog zlog ba blogros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa las/ slar nyung bsdus go bde byas pa zhig dgos zhes/
mtsho mdzad 'gro phan sogs 'ga' zhig gi bskul ba'i ngor smin grol skyed rdzogs gling du bdakod pa dge'o/ maṅga laṃ// 226)
